text:
incident-bot: PAGED: Elevated 5xx+timeouts observed on streaming-gateway (eu-west-1). Alert threshold crossed: 5xx rate 8% (SLO 0.5%). Paging oncall.
maria: acked, looking now. seeing spike from 07:42 -> 07:46 UTC. traffic normal but many truncated streams reported.
aj: oncall here. can you paste a recent gateway log tail + upstream errors?
maria: grabbing tails, filtering by 502/504 and chunked-cancel pattern. short snippet:
```
2026-03-15T07:45:12Z gate-3 nginx: upstream prematurely closed connection while reading response header from upstream, client: 10.2.3.4, server: streaming.redwood.internal, request: "GET /v1/stream?model=x HTTP/1.1", upstream: "http://backend-13:8080/stream", host: "streaming.redwood.internal"
2026-03-15T07:45:12Z backend-13 app: connection reset by peer while sending chunked response, writing 0 of 1024
```
sam: that looks like chunked response partial frame then reset. correlates with client cancels (mobile). any pattern by model or route?
maria: concentrated on /v1/stream and websocket proxying. non-stream endpoints stable (generate endpoint not impacted). throughput for streaming pods shows increased CPU wait and short spikes of OOM-kill-ish logs on backend-13.
opsbot: runbook hint: if streaming gateway sees upstream resets, try ephemeral routing and reduce streaming concurrency. See runbook link: https://internal/runbooks/streaming-upstream-resets
aj: let's reduce per-pod concurrency to 8 for streaming pods in eu-west-1 and rotate traffic. I'll push a temp override to the routing policy (canary style) to route 30% to eu-central and 70% to eu-west while we remediate.
maria: doing a quick canary shift via infra CLI:
```
infra route modify --service streaming-gateway --region eu-west-1 --concurrency 8
infra route split --service streaming-gateway --split eu-west-1=70,eu-central-1=30
```
sam: applied. watching metrics. 5xx % dropped from 8% -> 4.5% in 2m.
maria: confirming partial customers still reporting truncated outputs. opening customer-impact list: two enterprise customers (acme-corp, haloai) have ongoing sessions dropped ~10% of streams.
aj: notify CSMs with incident banner. I'll prepare status update: short explanation + mitigation steps and ETA for next update (15m).
maria: also instrumenting more detailed backend logs for chunk sizes and flush behaviour. adding additional logging on backend-13 (will increase noise):
```
kubectl exec -it deploy/backend-13 -- /bin/sh -c 'export EXTRA_LOG=stream_chunk_debug; kill -HUP 1'
```
opsbot: note: this will increase log volume; rate limit set on log-ingest.
sam: I see backend-13 has a lifecycle restart ~07:43 correlated to a scheduled node maintenance that overlapped with a spike of long-running streams. potential race between node drain and streaming eviction.
maria: good catch. node drain event id: nd-32f4. kube events show gracefulTerminationSeconds low for streaming pods (30s). clients waiting longer, streaming heads get cut.
aj: immediate remedy: increase terminationGracePeriodSeconds for streaming pods to 120 and set PodDisruptionBudget higher to avoid mass evictions. I'll open a patch.
maria: created PR to k8s config, applying rollout to eu-west-1 streaming pool only (so changes are staged): https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pull/5423
nina: jumping in for handoff in 30m. maria, can you summarize actions so I can continue?
maria: summary for handoff to nina:
- cause: upstream pod restarts + node drain overlap causing chunked responses to be reset.
- impact: ~8% 5xx on streaming-gateway peaked, some customers experiencing truncated streams.
- mitigations applied: lowered per-pod concurrency, split traffic to eu-central, enabled extra debug logs, raised restart grace on k8s planned, paged CSMs.
- next steps: watch for stabilization post-grace change, validate no regression when we scale concurrency back.
nina: got it. I'll take over monitoring and coordinate config rollback once stable. ETA check in 30m. ping me directly for urgent alerts.
aj: status update posted to status.redwood: "Investigating elevated streaming errors; traffic partially shifted; mitigations in progress." Will update again in 15.
maria: observed 5xx rate down to 1.2% after grace and routing changes fully rolled. backend-13 still logging chunked reset traces but at lower frequency.
sam: recommend schedule: 1) keep lowered concurrency for 2h, 2) raise terminationGracePeriod to 120 permanently for streaming pods, 3) add rolling drain coordination for long-lived streams (drain-delay label). I'll file followup ticket.
maria: filing followup ticket: https://issues.internal/RW-INC-2026-154 (contains full log excerpt, customers affected, remediation steps and owners).
nina: taking handoff. maria / aj / sam — thanks. if anything spikes >5% re-open paging. I'll mark this thread as monitored and will update in 30.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: reduced severity to P2 - impact limited to streaming endpoint; majority of traffic unaffected. Next update scheduled in 30 minutes. :white_check_mark:
